items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Well I played a job, a couple of jobs with Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Buddy Petit or did you hear him very much?
Well I played a job, a couple of jobs with Buddy Petit. At the last, after he had left and come back to New Orleans.

Where'd he been? I think Sammy Penn or someone told him, Sammy used to play for him. I think he said he went across the lake or act like he lived there with some relatives. Was it across the lake, Mandeville or anything? Do you know where it was?

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: With Buddy Petit? Yeah I played jobs too. Never played regular, but I mean occasionally

ctx.x: Let's see now those piano players, like that, wasn't that guy called Herman or something you had on the tape?

That's right, Herman. I played with him, well I played with him concerts and dances, but I was with a band with him, with Bill Hamilton and Lawrence Toka and Melvin Frank and Eddie Summers. What was Herman's name? I can't recall his name, because they used to call him Skeet, but his name was Herman, but I want to recall his name. What about Buddy Petit?
You talked about him, who did he have with him?
